title: Copy bundles for recipes and complete screens
summary: The consumer-copy projection behind /recipes and the composition inventory: every recipe demo and lesson shows, copies and downloads installed-consumer source, and the same bytes, with an adapted Settings 01, typecheck, build and work in fresh installed Vite, Next root app and Next src/app projects.

extraDependencies.reason: The generated projection holds the exact bytes the docs show and the installed consumers compile.
The installed-consumer checks install Settings 01 from the registry and adapt its labels and data as the worked block path.
Its @types packages decide the type packages a recipe's engine command installs.

supporting.reason: Renders the Projects screen in the workspace: form, selection, navigation, data and Dialog behavior before it is copied.
